description:
List the Site Audit projects (technical-crawl configurations) for a property, so an agent can discover the audit_id to pass (as the auditId argument) to the other site_audit tools. A property can have several audits; each returns audit_id, name, mode (list | complete | organic_traffic), device, start_urls, status (completed | running | idle | stuck), progress (0–100: percent of the current run while running or stuck, 100 once completed, 0 if never run), last_crawl_date (ISO 8601, null if never crawled), last_activity_at (ISO 8601 of the last processed page, null if this run has not processed a page yet), pages_crawled, and health_score (0–100 of the latest crawl, null if never crawled). stuck means credits were spent and the crawl is in-flight but no page has been processed for 15 minutes. Audits are returned latest-crawl first. Most site_audit tools default to the most-recently-finished audit when no audit_id is given, so this is only needed to target a specific audit. Pass the property ID (UUID) or URL (sc-domain:...) from list_properties.

Cost: 1 credit per call.

Examples:
```json
// List the property's Site Audit projects with their latest health score and crawl date.
{"property":"sc-domain:example.com"}
```
name: list_site_audit_projects
title: Site Audit projects
